name: claude-plugins-validation
description: Comprehensive validation suite for Claude Code plugins, marketplaces, hooks, skills, MCP servers, LSP servers, and rules. Includes 190+ validation rules from AgentSkills OpenSpec, Nixtla Quality Standards, and Meta-Skill frameworks. Features severity hierarchy (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/NIT/WARNING), --strict mode, language-aware token estimation, and detailed skill documentation for thorough plugin quality assurance.
